convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the iWPRSign indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position opening/closing/money management, which contains non-trivial trading logic that must be manually replicated.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp calculation
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Historical close signal search: when both buy-open and buy-close (or sell-open and sell-close) are enabled but no close signal on the current signal bar, the EA scans historical bars from SignalBar+1 forward looking for an opposite iWPRSign signal to generate a close signal. This prevents being stuck in a position without a close trigger on the current bar.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1), BALANCE=fraction of balance, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus floating loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus floating loss. The MM input value is interpreted differently depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The iWPRSign custom indicator is a Williams Percent Range signal generator that produces non-zero/non-EMPTY_VALUE outputs on buffer 1 (UpSignal) when WPR crosses above the UpLevel (-30), and on buffer 0 (DnSignal) when WPR crosses below the DnLevel (-70). The EA uses SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) for signal detection. An ATR period is passed to the custom indicator, likely for adaptive level calculation. The historical bar scan for close signals (lines 133-160) is a unique feature: when both open and close flags are enabled for a direction but no close signal appears on the current signal bar, it searches forward through historical bars to find the earliest opposite signal to trigger a close. This ensures positions can be closed even if the signal bar itself doesn't show a reversal. The BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans act as gates to enable/disable exit signals independently from entry signals. GlobalVariableDel_ from TradeAlgorithms.mqh cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: 1. The iWPRSign custom indicator must be replicated in Python - it wraps WPR with ATR-based adaptive signal generation using up/dn levels at -30/-70. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions and the MarginMode enum with 5 money management modes - all must be reimplemented. 3. The CIsNewBar class must be replicated for new bar detection. 4. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (not the forming bar), critical for avoiding look-ahead bias in backtesting. 5. The historical close signal scan (lines 133-160) is important: when both open+close are enabled for a direction but no close signal found on current bar, it scans subsequent bars for an opposite signal - this must be preserved exactly. 6. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips), so for 5-digit brokers these are 100/200 pips respectively - no additional digit adjustment is performed by the EA itself. 7. Deviation=10 is max slippage in points. 8. The LoadHistory() call ensures bar data is available before signal processing.
